verdict.rationale: Sift's own docs say it offers official SDKs for iOS and Android alongside its REST APIs. Its developer portal also shows per-language implementations (curl, Python, Java and more) with request/response examples, which suggests server-side client libraries. Missing for 10: explicit naming and documentation of server-side language SDKs (installation, versioning, coverage), and any independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Sift easily integrates into your existing systems using modern REST APIs, Javascript snippet, and SDKs for iOS and Android.
